Permanently Delete

This action allows you to permanently delete a business that has been previously removed from your list of active businesses.

Warning: This action is irreversible. Once a business is permanently deleted, all its data will be lost forever and cannot be recovered.

You can only permanently delete a business after it has been in the Removed Businesses list for at least 30 days. This waiting period helps prevent accidental permanent deletion.

To permanently delete a business, click the Permanently Delete button. You will need to confirm this action as it cannot be undone.
